notes: Total rubric = 11 (medium bucket 10-17). Four independent program-deliverables that must each generalise to fresh hidden inputs: ocr.py must OCR both image and (rendered-first-page) PDF scans under differing fonts/dpi and apply a two-marker invoice rule (word INVOICE AND a TOTAL-figure), surviving blank/whitespace and TOTAL-only edge scans; field-map.py must reproduce an exact TF-IDF(cosine) best-chunk mapping plus a well-formed per-field/aggregate statistics object, with token-less fields collapsing to a null chunk; chess-read.py reconstructs an 8x8 piece placement + side-to-move from a colour-palette board image with fixed documented geometry; extract.py re-captures exact name/email/phone/zip substrings with the documented regexes under edge cases (missing label, decoy email, malformed phone). Hidden-case generalization and quantitative correctness dominate; the grader re-runs all four programs on hidden inputs and compares exact JSON, plus independently re-derives the visible field-map. No resource/state/unsafety pressure; the medium difficulty equals the floor for all four claimed competencies.
